Physical Access.policy: All restricted rooms such as the server room, SOC, records room, and utility room require employee badges or biometrics to be accessed. Lobby doors use scanners to close automatically after each entry. High-value areas require two-person rule entry.
Physical Access.controls: Smart Gate mantraps, biometric scanners, automated door readers, security guard monitoring

Visitors and Vendors.policy: Visitors must be pre-registered in the visitor management system. Reception issues temporary badges with limited access. Visitor logs are retained for one year and monitored by the SOC team.
Visitors and Vendors.controls: Visitor management system, reception verification, temporary badges, escorts, SOC monitoring

Workstation Security.policy: All employee endpoints auto-lock after 3 minutes of inactivity. Screen privacy filters are mandatory in open areas. Unattended workstations must never be left unlocked or exposed.
Workstation Security.risk: Shoulder surfing, piggybacking, unattended endpoint compromise
Workstation Security.controls: 3-minute auto-lock, polarized privacy filters, clean-desk policy

Authentication and Authorization.policy: Lumina Systems requires MFA for all internal systems. Hardware-backed identity verification (FIDO2/WebAuthn) and RBAC determine access to source code, AI models, and production servers. Privilege escalation requires manager approval and SOC logging.
Authentication and Authorization.risk: Unauthorized digital access, credential theft, privilege escalation
Authentication and Authorization.controls: MFA, FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware keys, RBAC, least privilege, SOC escalation logging

Removable Media.policy: Sensitive data cannot be copied to removable storage devices under any circumstances unless given explicit permission. Exceptions require SOC approval and automatic malware scanning. USB ports are restricted except for approved devices.
Removable Media.risk: Unauthorized physical device or port access, data exfiltration, malware introduction
Removable Media.controls: Endpoint port restrictions, SOC exception approval, automated malware scanning

Document Disposal.policy: Sensitive documents, blueprints, and packaging labels must be broken down, shredded, or placed in approved locked destruction containers before disposal.
Document Disposal.controls: Locked destruction bins, package label destruction, cross-cut shredding, clean-desk policy

Power and Continuity.policy: Critical systems use UPS, surge protection, and underground lines. Selected AI services receive generator support, tamper-proof backups, and automated recovery procedures.
Power and Continuity.risk: Power and environmental disruption, service downtime
Power and Continuity.controls: UPS, surge protection, generator support, buried power lines, drone/AI inspection

Monitoring and Reporting.policy: Employees must report suspicious activity immediately. Centralized SIEM with WORM storage records all events and triggers automated alerts without jumping to conclusions prior to analyst investigation.
Monitoring and Reporting.risk: Delayed attack detection, log tampering, insider threat
Monitoring and Reporting.controls: Centralized SIEM engine, WORM storage, automated alert correlation, SOC review
